# the mediagraphy.in (KDMC Growth Lab)

> Digital marketing and content studio in Kalyan East, Maharashtra, India. We run Google Maps and local SEO, Meta lead campaigns, social media, landing pages, WhatsApp lead routing and on-site video shoots for local businesses in Kalyan, Dombivli, Ulhasnagar, Titwala, Ambernath, Badlapur and Thane. Plans start at Rs 5,999 a month (our fee only); ad spend is paid by the client directly to Google and Meta with no commission.

## Key facts
- Based in: Kalyan East, Maharashtra, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 86377 44905  |  Email: growth@themediagraphy.in  |  Hours: Mon–Sat, 10 AM–7 PM IST
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
- Run by three co-founders: Ayush Sahu, Prakhar Dubey, Nikhil Kushwaha. Not registered as a company, LLP or firm at present.
- Contract: month to month, no lock-in, written Service Agreement before any paid plan. No guaranteed results.
- Tax: not registered for GST at present; no GST is added
- Fact sheet: https://themediagraphy.in/about/

## Services
- [Google Maps & Local SEO](https://themediagraphy.in/services/google-maps-local-seo/): Own the 3-pack for "near me" searches, from Kalyan to Dombivli.
- [Meta Lead Campaigns](https://themediagraphy.in/services/meta-lead-campaigns/): Instagram and Facebook lead forms with Conversions API tracking, paid in ₹.
- [Social Media Management](https://themediagraphy.in/services/social-media-management/): Posts, reels and festival creatives in Marathi, Hindi or English.
- [Websites & Landing Pages](https://themediagraphy.in/services/websites-landing-pages/): Fast on 4G, mobile first, with a WhatsApp button on every page.
- [WhatsApp Lead Routing](https://themediagraphy.in/services/whatsapp-lead-routing/): Catalogues, auto-replies and enquiry routing to your sales team.
- [On-Site Video Shoots](https://themediagraphy.in/services/on-site-video-shoots/): We come to your shop, clinic or site. Quick turnaround.

## Plans (our monthly fee; ad spend is separate)
- Aarambh: Rs 5,999 a month. For single-shop owners getting started. Suggested ad spend Rs 3,000–8,000.
- Shuru: Rs 9,999 a month. For steady local visibility. Suggested ad spend Rs 8,000–15,000.
- Vikas: Rs 19,999 a month. For steady enquiries. Suggested ad spend Rs 15,000–30,000.
- Pragati: Rs 29,999 a month. For growing businesses. Suggested ad spend Rs 30,000–60,000.
- Shikhar: Rs 44,999 a month. Full-funnel, multi-service. Suggested ad spend Rs 60,000 and above.

## Areas we serve
- [Kalyan](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/kalyan/): Chinchpada, Kolsewadi, Khadakpada, Shivaji Chowk and Kalyan-Shil Road
- [Dombivli](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/dombivli/): Phadke Road, Tilak Road, Manpada Road, Gupte Road and Kopar
- [Ulhasnagar](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/ulhasnagar/): Camp 1 to Camp 5, Camp 3 Chowk and the main market lanes
- [Titwala](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/titwala/): Titwala station area, the Ganpati temple road and newer housing
- [Thane](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/thane/): Naupada, Gokhale Road, Majiwada, Vartak Nagar and Ghodbunder Road
- [Ambernath & Badlapur](https://themediagraphy.in/areas/ambernath-badlapur/): Ambernath East and West, Badlapur Gaon, Kulgaon and Katrap
